design.selection: frame-250 scan from each of 40 filename-defined acquisition series
design.local_or_hosted: local implementation of the published forward model

weak_mode_energy_fraction.definition: mean within-scan fraction of squared coefficient energy in 104 of 512 lateral modes with singular value below 0.05

interpretation.supported: The sign of MS-SSIM sensitivity to lateral regularization tracks encoding more strongly than phase selection in this matched sweep: both single-scatterer branches benefit from stronger damping over most or all of the tested range, while both phase-pair branches attain their highest mean at the weakest tested damping.
interpretation.not_established: The factorial sweep does not by itself prove that uncancelled single-scatterer broadband phase error causes the trend. That mechanism is analytically present and the trend is consistent with damping compensating its rendered error, but alternative interacting explanations such as smoothing, normalization, and ceiling effects are not separately isolated.
interpretation.scope: This is a post-review descriptive sensitivity analysis on a 40-scan subset under the local scanner, at one fixed axial regularization and two phase-iteration settings. It does not identify a universal or unique optimum and is not a hosted-scanner result.
